result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback position: Affiliates are covered without the fallback’s notice condition, and transfer is permitted to an M&A successor. It also covers contractors. It does not reach the preferred position because termination under Section 4 is not expressly limited to uncured material breach, and no perpetual, irrevocable treatment is provided for any paid-up licence. Deleting the prohibition on sublicensing is broader than necessary because contractors are already direct licensees; a limited exception would be more precise. The remaining changes are related to licence scope and generally preserve the commercial purpose.
